mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transport_trip ( id, trip_no, vehicle_id, route_id, departure_time, booking_deadline, price, status, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{tripNumber}, #{vehicleId}, #{routeId}, #{departureTime}, #{bookingDeadline}, #{price}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, trip_no, vehicle_id, route_id, departure_time, booking_deadline, price, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, trip_no, vehicle_id, route_id, departure_time, booking_deadline, price, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1 FOR SHARE
SELECT id, trip_no, vehicle_id, route_id, departure_time, booking_deadline, price, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, trip_no, vehicle_id, route_id, departure_time, booking_deadline, price, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE status = 'OPEN_FOR_BOOKING' AND booking_deadline > #{now} AND departure_time > #{now} ORDER BY departure_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, trip_no, vehicle_id, route_id, departure_time, booking_deadline, price, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE status = 'OPEN_FOR_BOOKING' AND booking_deadline <= #{now} ORDER BY booking_deadline ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, trip_no, vehicle_id, route_id, departure_time, booking_deadline, price, status, version, created_at, updated_at FROM transport_trip WHERE status = 'CLOSED' AND departure_time <= #{now} ORDER BY departure_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
